description: UCI row 34 (age 33, MEDIUM vulnerability, moderate knowledge, RT 8, horizon 3yr) — em equity etf: all hard rules pass, soft fails ['R3'] (score 85) -> SUITABLE
client_narrative: Chidera Eze is 33 years old. Their gross annual income is approximately 32,300 euros (around 2,692 euros per month). They hold 18,000 euros in liquid savings and wish to invest 1,900 euros with a 3-year investment horizon. In terms of financial background, the client has moderate investment experience, including equities, mutual funds, and standard bond instruments. Their investment approach is growth-oriented and risk-tolerant — they rate their risk appetite at 8 out of 10. They have stated they cannot afford to lose the full 1,900 euros invested. Their financial circumstances place them in the medium vulnerability category.
product_narrative: The product is a UCITS exchange-traded fund tracking the MSCI Emerging Markets Index, providing exposure to equity markets across 24 emerging-market countries. The fund publishes a KID, trades intraday on regulated exchanges, uses no leverage, and holds no embedded derivatives. It is classified NON-COMPLEX under MiFID II Article 25(4)(a). Due to elevated market and currency risk, moderate financial knowledge is expected from investors. The recommended minimum holding period is seven years.
